defects.defect: The scene-to-CTA gap is disproportionately large, leaving the lock nodes visually detached and weakening the screen's flow.
defects.direction: Tighten the vertical rhythm or expand the ladder into a more substantial framed progression module.

defects.defect: Ladder nodes are left of the horizontal center while title, scene panel and Play button are centered
defects.direction: Center the ladder column on the same vertical axis as the Play button, or intentionally stagger nodes as a winding path spanning the width

defects.defect: Ladder column is left-of-center (centered near x≈230 vs screen center x≈362) and floats on bare brown with no frame or path art, so the whole mid-screen reads unfinished and misaligned against the centered title, scene and Play button
defects.direction: Center the ladder on the screen axis or give it a framed/decorated map panel matching the scene panel width, so its center aligns with the title and Play button

defects.defect: Mages tab icon is a tiny cropped character sprite at a much smaller optical size than the Home/Rift/Settings icons and sits higher in its cell, breaking icon-row consistency
defects.direction: Replace with a purpose-built nav icon matched in size, weight and baseline to the other three tabs

defects.defect: The large uninterrupted brown area around the sparse level ladder reads unfinished rather than intentionally composed.
defects.direction: Add subtle environmental texture, framing, or more compact progression treatment while preserving the ladder hierarchy.
defects.region: Center, between hero scene and Play button
